gates.title: First-contact connector trust decision
gates.notes: A signed authorization request and independently derived authentication string now require exact local confirmation on desktop or the headless CLI, separately from portal consent. Cross-runtime, real-browser, Electron, restart, mismatch, revocation, and policy tests passed in the recorded CI run.

gates.title: Managed key service and rotation drill
gates.notes: AWS KMS wrapping is active in staging. The recorded drill rewrapped all collection and provider-check envelopes from V1 to V2, proved cold operation while V1 was disabled, replaced and rejected the old workload credential, and passed exact-image health plus signed semantic acceptance. V1 remains enabled only as a retained recovery artifact and is unavailable to the active workload.

gates.title: Encrypted backup and restore drill
gates.notes: Verify encrypted database and volume backups, restoration, key recovery, recovery objectives, and deletion behavior in the managed environment.
